title: Why the Cigarette Index is a useful reference point for alternative indices
summary: Fixture for a 1D3X article about the Cigarette Index as an external reference, without copying its implementation.

payload.excerpt: Fixture for a 1D3X article using the Cigarette Index as a reference case for alternative index design.
body_lines: The Cigarette Index is useful not because it should be copied, but because it demonstrates how unusual consumer items can anchor intuitive public benchmarks.
For 1D3X and POP, that makes it a good external reference when discussing what belongs in an alternative index library.
The main lesson is methodological: editorial clarity and a concrete benchmark story matter as much as the formula.
